verses.text: A psalm. Sing a new song to the LORD, because he has done amazing things! His right hand and his holy arm have won the victory.
The LORD has made his saving power known. He has shown the nations that he does what is right.
He has remembered his faithful love and his faithfulness to the people of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen our God save his people.
Shout with joy to the LORD, all the earth! Burst into songs of joy and praise!
Make music to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing.
With trumpets and the sound of the ram's horn, shout with joy in front of the LORD, the King.
Let the sea and everything in it roar, and the world and everyone who lives in it.
Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
Let them sing in front of the LORD, because he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world fairly and the peoples with justice.
